description: Newest Arkansas Supreme Court and Arkansas Court of Appeals opinions, newest first, read from the Arkansas Judiciary's official opinions archive every hour. Returns each decision's neutral citation (e.g. "2026 Ark. 140", "2026 Ark. App. 449"), case name, decision date, docket number, authoring judge, opinion type, disposition and a link to the opinion's own page on the court's site. Use for "what did the Arkansas Supreme Court decide this week", "latest Arkansas Court of Appeals opinions", or recent Arkansas appellate decisions since a date. Covers decisions from 2026-01-01 on.

court.description: "supreme" (Arkansas Supreme Court) or "appeals" (Arkansas Court of Appeals). Omit for both.

include_syllabi.description: Also list the courts' daily syllabus documents and no-opinion notices (default false).

since.description: Only decisions on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: ark_recent_opinions
title: Ark Recent Opinions
